content: Undocumented/unofficial API consumption pitfalls: (1) JSON response formats change without notice - current code uses JSONSerialization with string-coercion (as? String then Double()) which silently returns nil on format changes; (2) endpoints are unstable (minimax-usage-checker inspiration changed endpoints; platform.minimax.io/query_balance vs api.minimax.io differ); (3) silent failure mode: nil-returns render as '--' with no explanation; (4) stale-cache risk: cached balance may be weeks old if fetch keeps failing; (5) hardcoded URL strings are single points of failure. Mitigation: defensive decoding, error-state propagation to UI, cache timestamp visibility, endpoint constants isolated for one-line fixes.
